submissions.title: IREN's 2GW Sweetwater Hub Included as Base Load in ERCOT Batch Zero
submissions.excerpt: construction of 300MW (gross) of data center capacity continues with delivery targeted for Q4 2027
submissions.note: AUDIT: tracker's 2000 MW row for IREN Sweetwater carries methodology 'Basis: IT load', but this Sept 8 2026 IREN release frames the '2GW Sweetwater Hub' as an ERCOT Batch Zero base-load grid/interconnection classification (site/grid power), not IT load, and states only 300MW gross of data center capacity is actually under construction (delivery Q4 2027). Recommend correcting the 2000 MW metric's basis to site/grid power and recording 300MW gross-under-construction as a separate, lower-confidence data point. submissions.title: HUMAIN and DataVolt to develop AI data center in NEOM
submissions.excerpt: Construction is underway, with the first 100MW of capacity expected to become available in 2028.
submissions.note: AUDIT: tracker's analystNotes state 'no construction on this campus is documented as of mid-2026 — treat scale as aspirational' with a ~300MW first phase. The 1.5GW full-build target itself is unchanged and remains correctly a future target, not current capacity.
